brief.headline: Push for ₹32.69 L/yr saving by matching Shrinath's ₹290.00/KG price and offer faster payment to unlock the 81-day cash gap

priceAsk.summary: Ask them to match ₹290.00/KG across the top three SKUs where we overpay
priceAsk.target: ₹290.00/KG (Shrinath Roto Pack price) — saves us ₹32.69 L/yr
priceAsk.basis: We pay ₹294.03–₹308.30/KG to GEEP but only ₹290.00/KG to Shrinath for similar laminates; the market asking range is ₹205–305/kg with ₹250/kg typical, so ₹290 sits at the top of fair — we should pay no more than that across the board

paymentTermAsk.summary: Offer to pay in 15 days instead of 30 if they cut price to ₹290.00/KG
paymentTermAsk.cashImpact: Paying 15 days earlier frees up ₹1.16 Cr of our cash, but it's worth about 4.38% to them (their borrowing rate), so the faster payment buys us the price cut

brief.financialLeverage: They sell ₹291.36 Cr a year and keep only 1.1% as profit — very thin. We're 9.72% of everything they sell (₹28.31 Cr), so losing us would really hurt. Their cash is stuck for 81 days, much longer than similar firms at 46 days, which means they feel the pinch when money comes in slowly. They borrow at rates between 1.55% and 9.25%, so paying them faster has real value. Push firmly on price to match our best, and trade faster payment for that cut — but don't squeeze so hard you break a supplier who's already running tight and has GST and EPF delays on record.

evidence.point: We overpay by ₹32.69 L a year versus the best price we already get
Shrinath charges us ₹290.00/KG; GEEP charges ₹294.03–₹308.30/KG for the same sort of laminate
Market asking range for pharma ORS sachet laminate is ₹205–305/kg, verdict: top of fair band
Their cash is tied up for 81 days, longer than the 46 days typical for peers
We are 9.72% of their total sales
They keep 1.1% profit on every ₹100 sold — very little room

alternates.name: Huhtamaki India Ltd
alternates.why: Listed flexible-packaging converter already supplying FDC in small volume — proven, scalable second source for laminate sachets (₹2611.64 Cr revenue, health C 59/100)

alternates.name: UFLEX Ltd
alternates.why: Listed flexibles giant doing both film and conversion — can second-source GEEP at scale (₹16492.00 Cr revenue, health C 46/100)

alternates.name: Constantia Parikh Packaging Pvt Ltd
alternates.why: Part of global Constantia group, makes pharma blister and sachet laminates in India — strong credible backup (₹222.04 Cr revenue, health D 31/100)

risks: GEEP is 67% of our Laminates spend (₹28.31 Cr) — we have no real backup today, so qualify Huhtamaki or UFLEX fast before pushing too hard
Rating is CRISIL BB+ but the agency says the company stopped sharing info, so their financial health is uncertain — treat the numbers as stale and keep supply-continuity front of mind
They have GST filing delays, EPF payment delays, and pending legal cases — watch for supply hiccups; don't rely on them alone
Profit is only 1.1% — a big price cut could tip them into loss and hurt our supply; win the ₹32.69 L through matching our best price and trading faster payment, not a deeper squeeze
brief.suggestedOpeningLine: We value the partnership, but we're paying ₹294–₹308/KG when our best laminate price is ₹290 — let's talk about how we get there and whether faster payment helps you.
